yang_dicoba: Semantic Scholar API (abstrak sama, tanpa PDF akses terbuka)

klaim.bukti: We use images captured by a stereo camera and their 3D reconstruction to detect objects of interest [...] We achieve a F1 score of 0.977 with ground truth grape counts from images.
klaim.catatan: SLAM tingkat objek dari kamera stereo, anggur, dan F1 0,977 terhadap hitungan dari citra sesuai abstrak.

klaim.bukti: This paper investigates the application of eight color models for automatic palm oil Fresh Fruit Bunch (FFB) ripeness classification with multi-class Support Vector Machine (SVM). [...] Color moments were extracted from each of these color models
klaim.catatan: Kajian ini memakai fitur warna (color moment) dan SVM multikelas; bagian 'neural networks' pada kalimat merujuk kajian lain yang disitasi bersama.

klaim.bukti: Then the Byte tracker is deployed to track oranges in consecutive video frames. Further, we have classified the fruits into two categories, ripe and unripe using MobileVit.
klaim.catatan: Pelacak Byte dan pengklasifikasi terpisah MobileViT sesuai. Kajian juga menguji varian tiga kelas (unripe, partially-ripe, ripe; akurasi 86,7%), yang tidak disebut di kalimat tetapi tidak mengubah makna.

klaim.bukti: A Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) = 4.9 and 4.3 mm was achieved for estimated fruit length and width, respectively [...] but cannot be used in direct intense sunshine.
klaim.catatan: RMSE 4,9 mm (panjang) dan 4,3 mm (lebar) sesuai dengan 'about 4-5 mm'; batasan sinar matahari langsung dinyatakan di abstrak.
